title: rosa eglanteria var. lutea
intro: Rosa eglanteria var. lutea, commonly known as Yellow Rose of Lancaster, is a fragrant, yellow-flowered variant of the Rosa eglanteria species, a climbing rose native to the Americas. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, fever, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Rosa eglanteria var. lutea are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which have been shown to exhibit antioxidant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory activities. However, more research is needed to confirm the efficacy and safety of using this plant for medicinal purposes.
